message.content:
Based on the provided images, here is the description of the crops:

**(1) panel.png**
This crop contains the **white air conditioning unit** mounted at the top of the image. From top to bottom, it shows:
*   **Top:** The smooth white upper casing of the indoor AC unit.
*   **Middle:** A small sensor or indicator display (resembling a fan icon with a blue center line).
*   **Bottom:** The air outlet vents where cool air is blowing out (visible as light blue/white streams in the full image).

**(2) logo_dark_bg.png**
**No.** This crop does **not** contain the Celsius logo. It is simply a close-up of the **top portion of the white air conditioner unit** against the dark blue background. It focuses on the physical product details (the casing and vent area) rather than the branding text.

**(3) logo_white_trim.png**
*   **Wind Icon:** No, the wind icon is **not visible** in this specific crop.
*   **Wordmark:** No, the "Celsius" wordmark is **not readable** (or present) here.
*   **Content:** This image is a high-contrast version of the **air conditioner unit** shown in crop #2. It appears to be the same object but processed to show white/light gray details on a transparent/checkerboard background (likely an alpha mask or cutout of the appliance).
*   **Quality Rating:** If rating this as a clean asset of the **AC unit**, it is a **9/10** (clean edges, isolated subject). However, as a "logo" file, it is a **1/10** because it fails to contain any logo elements.
